verdict.rationale: OpenHands documents automations and workflows that integrate with Linear and other services, triggered on a schedule or by webhook events. That is first-party issue-tracker connectivity for one of the named trackers. The incident-triage automation mentions routing issues to owners but does not name a tracker. Missing for 10: Jira, ClickUp and Monday.com integrations, documentation of agents directly creating or updating tickets, setup or configuration docs for the Linear integration, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can connect issue trackers like Jira, Linear, ClickUp, or Monday.com so agents can manage tickets directly

citations.quote: Create automations and workflows that integrate with Slack, GitHub, Linear, and more.
Watch for new bugs or incidents, gather logs and recent changes, suggest severity, and route the issue to the right owner.
